description: Check a nudg file. Each problem has a stable code, a JSON pointer path, and a hint that says how to fix it. Pass `file`, or `source` to check text before writing it.

file.description: Path to a .nudg.json file, relative to the working directory.

path.description: With `source`: where the text would live, for resolving imports and labeling.

rev.description: With `file`: read it as it was at this git revision (HEAD, HEAD~1, a branch) instead of from disk, imports included.

source.description: The file's JSON text, to check before writing it. Imports resolve relative to `path`, or the working directory.

name: nudg_validate
title: Validate a nudg file
